description: Reviewed rule table: RL DefenseActionName -> D3FEND countermeasures. All outputs are simulation_derived=true and control_status=proposed: the RL policy was trained and evaluated in a simulator and never acts on real systems.

rules.rationale: The simulated 'isolate' action cuts a node off from the rest of the simulated network; D3FEND Network Isolation 'prevent[s] network hosts from accessing non-essential system network resources'.

unmapped.rate_limit: No D3FEND 1.6.0 technique specifically describes request-rate limiting; the nearest (D3-ITF Inbound Traffic Filtering) restricts traffic by origin, not by rate, so no mapping is asserted.
unmapped.raise_monitoring: The simulated action does not specify what is monitored, so no single D3FEND detection technique can be justified.
unmapped.request_reassessment: A workflow action, not a countermeasure.
unmapped.escalate_to_human: A workflow action, not a countermeasure.
